issue.description:
Plan: docs/plan/plan.md Phase 3a. Independent.

## Task
- src/workflows.py: `normalize_failure(message)` strips hex hashes, UUIDs, ISO timestamps, durations,
  pod/node names, absolute paths and numbers > 3 digits, lowercases, collapses whitespace, and returns
  (normalized_text, sha256[:12]).
- `failure_class` from a small reviewed rule table (`failure_classes.yaml`, ordered regexes):
  timeout, oom, clone_auth, image_pull, test_failure, lint, build, infrastructure, unknown.
- src/parquet_io.py: additive nullable columns `failure_fingerprint`, `failure_class`; schema
  conformance fills null for rows written by older releases.
- docs/notes/output-schema.md updated; tests with at least 12 real-looking messages covering every class.

## Acceptance
- Two messages differing only in ids/timestamps share a fingerprint; messages of different classes do not.
- Existing consumers (dashboard-site argo panel) unaffected; VERSION bumped.
issue.notes: Verified already shipped, no new work needed. HEAD 264dae7 (2026-09-06 05:21, 0.2.0) is on origin/main and the working tree matches it exactly for every work file. Re-ran the full suite (86 passed) and re-verified each acceptance criterion empirically: messages differing only in uuid/timestamp/hash/number/duration/path/pod-name all share a fingerprint; all 20 corpus messages have pairwise-distinct fingerprints; conform() fills failure_fingerprint/failure_class with null for rows written pre-0.2.0 and the result round-trips through the new RUNS_SCHEMA; raw failed_step_message and message are kept unchanged so existing column-name-based consumers are unaffected; 20 real messages cover all 9 classes (requirement was >=12); VERSION bumped to 0.2.0. Dispatch marker .needle-predispatch-sha equals HEAD, i.e. this bead was re-dispatched after its own commit had landed - the earlier run presumably died before closing it.
